text:
anya (CS Ops): Heads up — noticed ~1.2k accounts stuck in `onboard_in_progress` with no activity for 45+ days. Seeing a small but consistent healthscore drift in that cohort. Can we do a controlled sweep/dry-run? Query below for quick sanity check.

```sql
SELECT account_id, owner, onboarding_stage, last_activity_at
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE onboarding_stage = 'onboard_in_progress'
  AND last_activity_at < now() - interval '45 days'
  AND is_active = true;
```

leo w: Yikes. Do we have an existing auto-exit rule for stale onboard flows, or is that still manual? Who owns the criteria?

maria - onboarding: We have a soft-exit in the playbook v2 but it's gated behind `cs.onboard_auto_exit` flag. I remember some false positives when we first tested it. Recommend sampling first :eyes:

anya (CS Ops): Agreed. Proposal: run a dry-run on a 5k sample (random) and compute healthscore delta and reactivation rate within 14 days. Dry-run should only tag records as "eligible_for_exit" (no state changes). Sample filter: last_activity_at < now() - 45d AND onboarding_stage != 'complete' AND owner IN (select id from users where team = 'cs').

samira (CS Ops): I can run the 5k sample and post diffs (healthscore distribution pre/post, churn risk buckets). ETA EOD today.

leo w: pinging @playbook-bot to schedule a dry-run job on staging (so we can validate the orchestration and inspect logs).

playbook-bot: Scheduled job `dryrun_onboard_exit_20260323_47` on staging. Will emit results to #customer-success-reports when done.

maria - onboarding: If sample looks clean, safe-exit behavior we should apply: set status -> 'stalled', create a re-engage task for owner, and apply a small healthscore decrement (eg -0.05) to reflect engagement risk. Also ensure we add a 14-day reactivation window where an account returns to prior state if activity resumes.

anya (CS Ops): Sounds good. Need a short owner-nudge template before flipping anything. I'll draft copy and attach to the runbook. Also want a rollback plan: manual restore endpoint + audit log.

leo w: tagging @nate (data-eng) for telemetry hook — we want a metric for accounts that re-activate within 14d post-exit so ops can watch false positives.

nate (data-eng): On it — I'll emit `onboarding.stale_reactivate_count` and `onboarding.stale_exit_rate` to Grafana. ETA tomorrow morning. Will also add a small dashboard for the sample job.

anya (CS Ops): Action items:
- samira: run 5k sample dry-run + post full report to #customer-success-reports
- maria: review owner-nudge copy and re-engage task payload
- nate: add metrics and dashboard tiles (stale_reactivate_count, stale_exit_rate)
- leo: coordinate flag flip if sample OK and ops signoff

I'll update the runbook stub: /docs/cs/onboard-stale-exit.md (draft) after the sample.

samira (CS Ops): :thumbsup: I'll post CSV and quick viz when job completes.

maria - onboarding: +1 — will prep copy and a short playbook checklist.

playbook-bot: Job `dryrun_onboard_exit_20260323_47` completed on staging. Sample: 5,000 accounts -> 3,620 eligible (72%). Median healthscore delta: -0.03. Reactivations within 14d (dry-run observed by historical sim): 4.2%. Report: https://redwood-reports.internal/cs/reports/dryrun/20260323-47

leo w: Nice. Samira, can you run the same on a weekday production shard but with a smaller sample (1k) as a final safety check?

samira (CS Ops): Yep — scheduling now. Will include a CSV diff, sample account list for manual spot-check, and the healthscore histograms.

anya (CS Ops): Thanks all. Will circulate final runbook update and the owner-nudge copy once those artifacts are in.

nate (data-eng): I'll post the Grafana dashboard link when tiles are ready.

maria - onboarding: Thanks — excited to close this gap.
